upstream.description: A collection of projects designed to help developers quickly get started with building deployable applications using the Claude API

classification.analysis: Anthropic's official collection of starter projects for building on the Claude API, including a customer support agent, financial data analyst, computer-use and browser-use demos, an autonomous coding agent built on the Claude Agent SDK, and several Managed Agents examples (chat SDK, CopilotKit/AG-UI, knowledge wiki). Each subproject is a self-contained, cloneable reference implementation with its own README and setup steps, meant for developers learning Claude API patterns like tool use, computer use, and multi-agent orchestration. Mixed Python/TypeScript stack with Docker support for the computer/browser-use demos.
